Spec 0004: Schemas free of sample names: one key of any name, a heading role, generator tests on their own sources (Status: Accepted, 2026-11-15); removes the two sample names (greeting_recipient, the greeting role) that the foundation schemas still require

Decision: Option 1, fix the two schemas in place (one key of any name through minProperties), rename the required typography role greeting to heading in one change across the source, both generated files and three readers, and give the generator tests their own source tree
nodes.rationale: The ownership split of spec 0003 settles it: a foundation owned schema or test that names shared content breaks as soon as a product replaces the sample. Option 2 leaves the coupling in the tests; Option 3 gives up the required-role check the native code relies on.

nodes.label: Invariant: a consumed role is renamed in one change with every reader on both platforms; no alias is kept

Role heading in design-system/tokens/typography.json: "greeting": { "scale": "headline", "weight": "semibold" } becomes "heading" with the same scale and weight; it means the most prominent line of text on a screen; no alias for the old name is kept
nodes.rationale: heading says where the text is used and is not a platform style name, so it reads correctly beside SwiftUI .title and the Material slot headlineLarge.
